rendering_library: OpenCV raster drawing and PNG encoding; WFDB waveform decoding
layout: 12 aligned rows; all 10 seconds of each lead; no rhythm-strip duplication
gain_policy: Reduce the page-wide gain from 10 by powers of two only when any absolute waveform value would exceed the 12-mm half-height. No gain increase, per-lead gain, baseline shift, filtering or sample removal. Plot and record the actual gain and a 1-mV calibration pulse.
printed_text: Lead names and fixed technical calibration only; no patient ID, ECG ID, demographics, dates, SCP code or diagnostic label
label_policy: All present SCP-code keys mapped through diagnostic==1; no likelihood threshold. Five overlapping binary targets. Records without mapped diagnostic superclasses retained as images but excluded from the classification manifest.
split_policy: Official patient folds: 1-8 train, 9 validation, 10 test. Every source ECG rendered once; no split search or class balancing.
preview_policy: Development only: first training record for each diagnostic superclass plus deterministic training amplitude extremes; freeze style after visual and numerical checks before full generation.
randomness: None; deterministic clean rendering. No random augmentation or model training.
limitations: Synthetic clean ECG pages, not real scans or photographs. Rasterization is not lossless signal storage: 500-Hz source points share pixels at 200 horizontal pixels/second. Native waveforms remain the authoritative numerical signal. Page-wide gain can vary and is explicitly calibrated; low-gain and flat-lead records are flagged, not silently discarded.
